<?php
class QuietCloneCoalesceGet {
    public function __isset(string $incoming): bool { echo "I;"; return true; }
    public function __get(string $incoming): object { global $reader, $selector, $held; echo "G;"; $saved = $held; $held = null; $reader = null; $selector = "changed"; return $saved; }
    public function __destruct() { echo "RECEIVER;"; }
}
function quietCloneCoalesceRight(): int { echo "BAD_RHS;"; return 9; }
$seed = function() { echo "CALL;"; return 7; };
$middle = clone $seed;
$held = clone $middle;
$seed = null;
$middle = null;
$watch = WeakReference::create($held);
$reader = new QuietCloneCoalesceGet;
$selector = "value";
$answer = $reader->$selector ?? quietCloneCoalesceRight();
echo $answer === $watch->get() ? "SAME;" : "BAD_CLOSURE;";
echo $answer() === 7 ? "RESULT;" : "BAD_RESULT;";
echo $held === null && $reader === null && $selector === "changed" ? "CAPTURE;" : "BAD_CAPTURE;";
unset($answer);
echo $watch->get() === null ? "RETIRED;" : "BAD_OWNER;";
$watch = null;
echo "DONE;";

<?php
class QuietCloneAssignPayload {
    public function __destruct() { global $watch; echo "PAYLOAD;"; echo $watch->get() === null ? "CLOSURE_GONE;" : "BAD_CLOSURE;"; }
}
class QuietCloneAssignGet {
    private int $value = 41;
    public function __isset(string $incoming): bool { echo "I;"; return true; }
    public function __get(?string $incoming): object { global $reader, $selector, $held; echo "G;"; $saved = $held; $held = null; $reader = null; $selector = "changed"; return $saved; }
    public function __set(string $incoming, $value): void { echo "BAD_SET;"; }
    public function __destruct() { echo "RECEIVER;"; }
}
function quietCloneAssignRight(): int { echo "BAD_RHS;"; return 9; }
$payload = new QuietCloneAssignPayload;
$seed = fn() => $payload;
$held = clone $seed;
$seed = null;
$payload = null;
$watch = WeakReference::create($held);
$reader = new QuietCloneAssignGet;
$selector = "value";
$answer = $reader->$selector ??= quietCloneAssignRight();
echo $answer === $watch->get() ? "SAME;" : "BAD_CLOSURE;";
echo $answer() instanceof QuietCloneAssignPayload ? "RESULT;" : "BAD_RESULT;";
echo $held === null && $reader === null && $selector === "changed" ? "CAPTURE;" : "BAD_CAPTURE;";
unset($answer);
echo $watch->get() === null ? "RETIRED;" : "BAD_OWNER;";
$watch = null;
echo "DONE;";
